items.title: WMG and Spotify talk AI remixes and the need for artist consent
items.excerpt: Music Ally's read-out of the Morgan Stanley European TMT conference, where WMG and Spotify executives discussed AI remixes and the need for artist consent (Music Ally body is partly paywalled; og summary).

items.title: Instagram launches content protection tool for unauthorised reposts and AI-modification
items.excerpt: Instagram is rolling out 'content protection', which detects unauthorised reposts of creators' original Reels and is being extended to flag AI-modified versions of their content - relevant to musicians whose clips get remixed by AI.

items.title: Agentic AI in music marketing: 'superhumans', safeguards and 7am inbox briefs
items.excerpt: Music Ally on how music marketing is moving from asking chatbots questions to agentic AI - 'superhumans', safeguards and automated 7am inbox briefs (body partly paywalled; og summary).

items.title: 'If you can't defeat it, you have to join it': Peter Gabriel makes his stance on AI clear
items.excerpt: Peter Gabriel reaffirms his AI-aligned view of music's future, arguing artists should engage with AI tools rather than try to fight them.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd urges Congress to pass NO FAKES Act to combat AI deepfakes
items.excerpt: CAA CEO Bryan Lourd urged Congress on Saturday to pass the NO FAKES Act, the voice-and-likeness bill backed by the music industry, to regulate unauthorised AI deepfakes.

items.title: 김하온 복제한 AI 등장…"일주일 안에 넘어보겠다"
items.excerpt: 래퍼 김하온과 그의 목소리·말투·음악을 학습한 AI 도플갱어 '노아(NOAH)'가 SBS 다큐 '나의 이방인' 3부 'AI, 나를 닮은 너'(22일 방송)에서 랩 대결을 펼친다.

items.title: 시험장에서 금지된 AI 안경, 공연장에선?
items.excerpt: 수능 AI 부정행위로 주목받은 스마트 안경이 공연장에서도 촬영·녹음을 통한 공연 저작권 침해 수단으로 우려되면서, 공연계의 반입·관리 대응을 짚었다.

items.title: The Show Before the Show: How AI Can Help Build More Profitable Music Tours
items.excerpt: AI-powered forecasting and routing/optimization tools are being used by artists and promoters to plan more profitable tours; Hypebot walks through how they work.

items.title: Hive Launches AI Assistants to Help Venues and Promoters Sell More Tickets
items.excerpt: Fan-marketing platform Hive launched AI assistants that automatically draft email and SMS campaigns for venues and promoters, freeing live-event marketers to focus on strategy and creative.

items.title: Universal Music Lambasts 'Walled Garden' Criticism as 'A Complete Flip of Reality'
items.excerpt: UMG's Michael Nash and Matt Ellis defended the label's rights-managed 'walled garden' approach to AI music at a Morgan Stanley conference, distancing it from Warner's more open stance.

items.title: IMPALA's Helen Smith on Taking on Streaming Fraud: 'The Integrity of the Digital Music Market Is at Stake'
items.excerpt: IMPALA chair Helen Smith calls for artist verification, KYC checks and penalties as mass-uploaded AI-generated tracks and fake plays divert royalties; she cites Deezer's ~90,000 fully AI tracks a day.

items.title: Music may be excluded from Australia's AI-friendly copyright reforms - though ARIA says it stands with the rest of the creative industries
items.excerpt: Reports suggest Australia's proposed AI-training copyright exception may exclude music, but ARIA says it remains committed to the wider creative-industry campaign against the reforms.

items.title: Mooer debuts Future Flex, a next-gen amp modeler with a built-in speaker, AI and NAM A2
items.excerpt: Mooer's Future Flex all-in-one amp modeler packs 55 amp models, 69 effects, a built-in speaker, an AI tone assistant and NAM A2 neural-capture compatibility.

items.title: Binding of Isaac fans review bomb DLC after discovering GTA 6 mode songs are AI
items.excerpt: Players found that songs in a secret GTA 6-themed run shipped with The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'s console launch appear to be AI-generated, prompting fans to review-bomb the DLC.

items.title: Jimi Hendrix's sister admits it's 'tough' when people create AI fakes of the guitarist
items.excerpt: Janie Hendrix, CEO of Experience Hendrix, tells Guitar.com she finds AI-generated fake videos and photos of her brother 'tough', saying they are 'nothing like the real person'.

items.title: Harmonic Circuit: Chord Progression Lies in a Sparse Principal Information Flow in Symbolic Music Models
items.excerpt: Mechanistic-interpretability study that locates sparse 'circuits' inside symbolic music transformers responsible for chord-progression prediction, opening a path to more controllable AI composition models.
